class.name: IfcAppliedValueRelationship
class.brief_description: An IfcAppliedValueRelationship is a relationship class that enables cost values to be aggregated together as components of another cost value. HISTORY New Entity in Release IFC2.0. IFC2x4 CHANGE Subtyped from IfcResourceLevelRelationship , attribute order changed.
